state.faq_question: What is the maximum file size for uploads?
state.verified_answer: The maximum file size for uploads is 25 MB per file.

passages.text: You can upload files up to 25 MB in size. Larger files must be split before uploading.
The upload limit is 10 MB per file. Contact support for bulk transfers.
We now support parallel batch uploads for large datasets, with automatic retry on failure.
